描述_EN: this dish is a splendid example of craftsmanship from the period of the song dynasty (960-1279), and shows the luxury and prosperity enjoyed by a certain sector of society. gold was used only in the imperial courts or in the homes of the wealthiest urban residents. we do not know what was served in or eaten from this dish, but the small size suggests that it might have been used as a serving dish for sweetmeats, pickles, or for an individual helping of a meal, in which case it was likely to have been part of a large service. the lotus design in the centre is unlikely to have any link to the food served in it even though both lotus roots and seeds were common ingredients.
描述_ZN: 此盘是宋代（960-1279）时期工艺的杰出范例，显示了社会中某一阶层所享有的奢侈和繁荣。 黄金只在朝廷或最富有的城市居民家中使用。 我们不知道这个盘子里装的是什么或吃的是什么，但它的小尺寸表明它可能被用作盛放甜食、腌制食品的盘子，或用于单独的饭菜，在这种情况下，它可能是大型服务的一部分。 中间的莲花图案不太可能与盛放的食物有任何联系，尽管莲藕和种子都是常见的原料。
